modificationDescription: @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 base, renamed to Ultimate's `u-` prefix (A6, ADR-081): `.p-collapsible-*`, `.p-disabled`, `.p-component:disabled`, `.p-icon`, `.p-overlay-mask*` and `.p-anchored-overlay-*` become `.u-*`, and the `p-animate-*` keyframes become `u-animate-*`. Omitted: the page-wide `*, ::before, ::after { box-sizing: border-box }` rule (ADR-063 scopes border-box per component instead) and the PrimeIcons `.pi` rule (Ultimate ships no PrimeIcons font). The `var(--px-mask-background, ...)` wrapper is dropped in favour of `dt('mask.background')`, the same recorded difference as PX-B3 in the component style ports.
Barrel re-export hand-rebuilt by cross-referencing the built .d.mts/.mjs output; the original upstream barrel was a pure re-export the sourcemap does not capture as a separately-mapped file.

Manually transcribed from the tarball's dist/types.d.mts declaration file (dist/types.mjs.map has empty sources, so extract-source.mjs recovers nothing for it); StyleType was deliberately narrowed from upstream's real union type and the @primeuix/styled import was stripped, per this file's own header comment.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3 (Task 11, following Task 3's same extraction mechanism since Badge's own uix-styles module was not part of Task 3's original 5-module set); .p-badge* class-name string literals renamed to .u-badge* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-button* class-name string literals renamed to .u-button* (including the sibling .p-badge reference used for button badges, renamed to .u-badge) to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-checkbox* class-name string literals renamed to .u-checkbox* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Generic shared-state selectors (.p-disabled, .p-invalid, .p-variant-filled) left unrenamed, consistent with the base module's own treatment of framework-level classes.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-dialog* class-name string literals renamed to .u-dialog* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Generic shared selector (.p-resizable-handle) and @keyframes identifiers left unrenamed, consistent with the base module's own treatment of framework-level classes.

Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-menu* class-name string literals renamed to .u-menu* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Generic shared-state selectors (.p-disabled, .p-focus) left unrenamed, consistent with the base module's own treatment of framework-level classes.
Extracted via sourcemap recovery from @primeuix/styles@2.0.3; .p-tooltip* class-name string literals renamed to .u-tooltip* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision.

Directly ported from the extracted @primeuix/styles@2.0.3 virtualscroller module (loader mask/icon dt() token references only — upstream's virtualscroller style module has no structural/layout CSS of its own, unlike badge/button/checkbox/dialog/menu/tooltip); .p-virtualscroller-loader/.p-virtualscroller-loading-icon class-name string literals renamed to .u-scroller-loader/.u-scroller-loading-icon to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Consumed by all three frameworks' scroller-style.ts modules (packages/ng, packages/react, packages/vue) via ${virtualscrollerStyle} interpolation.

Directly ported from the extracted @primeuix/styles@2.0.3 paginator module (root/content/first/prev/next/last/page structural CSS with dt() token references); .p-paginator* class-name string literals renamed to .u-paginator* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Consumed by all three frameworks' paginator-style.ts modules (packages/ng, packages/react, packages/vue) via ${paginatorStyle}/${paginatorCss} interpolation. Exports only a plain style: string (no pre-shaped classes resolver), same shape as the base/badge/button/checkbox/dialog/menu/tooltip modules — each consuming framework's own paginator-style.ts authors its own classes map locally, matching button-style.ts's established pattern (see each framework's own provenance entry).

Directly ported from the extracted @primeuix/styles@2.0.3 datatable module (root/table/thead/tbody/row structural CSS with dt() token references); .p-datatable* class-name string literals renamed to .u-table* to match Phase 2's Ultimate namespace decision. Exports only a plain style: string (no pre-shaped classes resolver), same shape as the base/badge/button/checkbox/dialog/menu/tooltip/paginator modules — each consuming framework's own table-style.ts authors its own classes map locally, matching button-style.ts's/paginator-style.ts's established pattern (see each framework's own provenance entry). Consumed by all three frameworks' table-style.ts modules (packages/ng, packages/react, packages/vue) via ${tableStyle}/${tableCss} interpolation.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/inputnumber/index.ts, recovered from dist/inputnumber/index.mjs.map sourcesContent (GAP-094 backfill batch 1). Only .p-inputnumber* selectors are renamed to .u-inputnumber*; the shared .p-floatlabel, .p-inputtext-sm/-lg and .p-icon selectors are kept. Verified: applying that rename to upstream yields this file byte for byte. Added in d3048a46 (Angular base-input Plan).

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/inputtext/index.ts, recovered from dist/inputtext/index.mjs.map sourcesContent (GAP-094 backfill batch 1). Only .p-inputtext* selectors are renamed to .u-inputtext*; the .p-invalid and .p-variant-filled modifiers are kept. Verified: applying that rename to upstream yields this file byte for byte. Added in 541238d7 (Angular form-foundation Plan) and rewritten to this faithful copy in 3da383df.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/avatar/index.ts, recovered from dist/avatar/index.mjs. Only .p-avatar* selectors are renamed to .u-avatar*. One rule is added: `.u-avatar-clickable { cursor: pointer; }` for PrimeReact's click styling (ADR-087). Shared by the Angular, React and Vue avatar and avatar group style modules (ADR-082). Changed for #201.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/floatlabel/index.ts, recovered from dist/floatlabel/index.mjs (ADR-082, #191). The `.p-floatlabel*` selectors are renamed to `.u-float-label*` (the name Ultimate already emits), and the sibling-field selectors are changed to the classes the Ultimate siblings emit: `.p-inputtext` becomes `.u-inputtext`, `.p-multiselect-label` becomes `.u-multi-select-label`, `.p-cascadeselect-label` becomes `.u-cascade-select-label`, `.p-inputicon` becomes `.u-input-icon`, `.p-treeselect-label` becomes `.u-treeselect-label`, and `.p-chip` becomes `.u-chip`. The state classes `p-filled`, `p-invalid` and `p-inputwrapper-*` are kept, because the siblings emit them unrenamed. Upstream's `.p-multiselect-label:has(.p-chip)` and `.p-treeselect-label` padding selectors are carried, which the earlier local copies had dropped. Shared by the Angular, React and Vue float label style modules.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/iconfield/index.ts, recovered from dist/iconfield/index.mjs (ADR-082, #192). The `.p-iconfield*` selectors are renamed to `.u-icon-field*` and `.p-inputicon` to `.u-input-icon`, the names Ultimate emits. The sibling-field selectors follow the classes the Ultimate siblings emit: `.p-inputtext` becomes `.u-inputtext`, and the size rules accept both `.u-inputtext-sm`/`-lg` and `.u-inputfield-sm`/`-lg`. The `p-inputwrapper` state class is kept because the siblings emit it unrenamed. Shared by the Angular, React and Vue icon field style modules.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/iftalabel/index.ts, recovered from dist/iftalabel/index.mjs (ADR-082, #193). The `.p-iftalabel*` selectors are renamed to `.u-ifta-label*` and `.p-inputicon` to `.u-input-icon`, the names Ultimate emits. The sibling-field selectors follow the classes the Ultimate siblings emit: `.p-inputtext` becomes `.u-inputtext`, `.p-multiselect-label` becomes `.u-multi-select-label`, `.p-cascadeselect-label` becomes `.u-cascade-select-label`, `.p-treeselect-label` becomes `.u-treeselect-label`, and `.p-chip` becomes `.u-chip`. The state classes `p-invalid` and `p-inputwrapper-focus` are kept, because the siblings emit them unrenamed. Upstream's `.p-multiselect-label:has(.p-chip)` and `.p-treeselect-label` padding selectors are carried, which the earlier local copies had dropped. Shared by the Angular and Vue ifta label style modules.

Copy of @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 src/inputgroup/index.ts, recovered from dist/inputgroup/index.mjs (ADR-082, #194). The `.p-inputgroup*` selectors are renamed to `.u-input-group*`, and the `.p-iconfield`, `.p-floatlabel` and `.p-iftalabel` wrappers to `.u-icon-field`, `.u-float-label` and `.u-ifta-label`. The sibling-field selectors follow the classes the Ultimate siblings emit: `.p-inputtext` becomes `.u-inputtext`, and the focus rule keys on the `.p-focus` state class the Select family emits (upstream's `.u-focus` is not rendered by any component). Upstream's `.p-inputwrapper` and `.p-inputwrapper-focus` state classes are kept, because the siblings emit them unrenamed. Shared by the Angular and Vue input group style modules.
